purpose: co-create a vessel, curate a bounded life/instance inside it, preserve provenance, then distill the instance back to primitives
time_rule: every instance carries an as_of timestamp; later re-witnessing creates a new snapshot rather than rewriting the old one

collaboration.human: intent, selection, meaning, corrections, final creative authority
collaboration.assistant: research, organization, derivation, transformation, provenance, implementation
collaboration.invariant: neither silently rewrites the other's stated intent

duality.kana_witness: identity + provenance + instance intent survive phase traversal
